title: What If All the Ice Melted?
lines: What if all the ice on Earth melted?
Antarctica holds about {90 percent~ninety percent} of the world's ice.
If all the ice on land melted, | the oceans would rise about {70 meters~seventy meters}.
That's almost up to the chest of the Statue of {Liberty./~Liberty.}
Most of Florida | would be underwater.
Venice would vanish. | So would Amsterdam.
But the sea has {moved/~moved} the other way, too.
{20,000 years~Twenty thousand years} ago, in the last ice {age,/~age,} | the sea was about {120 meters~one hundred twenty meters} lower.
You could have walked from France to England, | or from Siberia to Alaska.
Coastlines aren't fixed. | The ice decides where they are.
How much has the sea risen since {1900~nineteen hundred}? | About {20 centimeters~twenty centimeters}, or about {2 meters~two meters}? | Tell me in the comments.

preroll.line: Melt all the ice on Earth, | and the sea rises about {70 meters~seventy meters}.
